canonical_accuracy.justification: One absolute percentage point; approximately 41 of the planned 4096 source clusters. Study-defined benchmark-scale floor, not a clinical tolerance.

canonical_nll.justification: ln(1.01), corresponding to approximately a one-percent multiplicative change in geometric-mean target probability. Study-defined benchmark-scale floor.

canonical_brier.justification: One percent of the implemented two-class multiclass Brier mathematical range [0,2]. Study-defined benchmark-scale floor, not clinical utility.

semantic_js.justification: ln(2)/100, one percent of the binary Jensen-Shannon divergence mathematical maximum. Study-defined benchmark-scale floor.
